name: Employee Clock In-Out Notification
script:
#frappe.log_error(\"Clock\"+doc.log_type)
# Fetch employee data
employee_data = frappe.get_doc('Employee', doc.employee)
   #fields=['employee_name', 'cell_number', 'prefered_email'])
#Check if employee data is found

if employee_data:
    employee_name = employee_data.employee_name
    cell_number = employee_data.cell_number
    prefered_email = employee_data.prefered_email
    Subject = f\"{employee_name} has Clock-{doc.log_type} at {doc.time}\"
    # Define the message content
    message_content = f\"Hello {employee_name} 
 You have sucessfully clock {doc.log_type } at { doc.time }
This is a bot.
beep bop beep bap.





From:Employee Clock In-Out Notification\"
    # Send the SMS using Frappe's native SMS functionality
    try:
        frappe.sendmail(
		recipients=prefered_email,
		subject= Subject,
	    message=message_content,
        now = True
    );
        #frappe.log_error(f\"Message sent to {employee_name} at {prefered_email}\")
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(f\"Failed to send message: {str(e)}\")
else:
    frappe.log_error(\"Employee not found.\"+doc.employee)
